shell.native_exit_codes: Explicitly capture and evaluate actual exit code; ErrorActionPreference alone does not handle every native nonzero result.

tool_boundary.capture: Await each tools.exec_command result, retain the full returned object and emit the full metadata rather than text(output) alone.
tool_boundary.persist: Save full result unchanged to a separately identified record after return and before the next scope action. Missing fields remain absent/null with explanation; never infer rc from output.
tool_boundary.output: Bound individual reads to avoid truncated results; preserve original native stdout/stderr as files for the single approved session.
tool_boundary.running: Initial running result and final wait result belong to one session and must both be saved.
tool_boundary.exceptions: If tool itself rejects/throws/aborts, preserve actual available exception/cancellation; do not fabricate a native rc.
tool_boundary.future_return: A record cannot contain its own future tool return. Distinguish snapshots, serialization and later actual returns.

actions_allowed_after_error: notify root and cancel any text-only assistants
record first and available subsequent error without replacing it
retain acquired outputs and list NOT_RUN cases
only authorized owned-child cleanup if one exists
record incomplete and preserve/package within reserved phase budgets

governance: This file is a document requirement, not a runtime guard implementation or test result.
